extracted.intended_audience: directorate planners and office directors responsible for preparing agency budget reports under OMB Circular A-44
extracted.subtask_description: Agency-level implementation instructions for preparing and submitting the required A-44 reports, specifying deadlines, report recipients, which sections to include, coverage periods, and limits on report scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report deadline and exclusion of FY1970
rubrics_metrics.description: The first report to be submitted to the Chief, DD/S Plans Staff no later than 21 December 1970 should include nothing at all regarding FY 1970.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This initial report is necessary because the data was not included when the last budget went forward, and the report covers the period of time between 1 January and 30 June 1971.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial report content — Sections I and II only
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial report shall include only Section I, 'Management Effectiveness Goals,' and Section II, 'Cost Reduction Goals.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include the other sections in the initial report; reserve inclusion of all sections for the first full report.

rubrics_metrics.name: First full report deadline and coverage period
rubrics_metrics.description: The first full report will be submitted so as to reach the Executive Director‑Comptroller on 30 June 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This report will contain all four sections and will cover the period 1 July 1971 - 30 June 1972.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report recipient routing
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial and full reports have specified internal recipients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The initial (partial) report is to be submitted to the Chief, DD/S Plans Staff. The first full report must reach the Executive Director‑Comptroller by the stated deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit reports to your own office's budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Your reports should be limited to your own Office’s budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is necessary in order to avoid confusion as to who claims what savings or budgetary allocations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Future integration with normal budget submittals (desideratum)
rubrics_metrics.description: It is hoped that the reporting instructions can, at some future date, be modified to permit inclusion of the information called for in the annual report in the normal budget submittals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an expressed objective for future procedural simplification, not an immediate requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment and deadline note (routing slip remark)
rubrics_metrics.description: This amends our memorandum, same subject, dated 13 November 1970. The deadline remains 14 December 1970.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Routing slip indicates an amendment to a prior memorandum and reiterates an existing deadline (14 December 1970) — check which deadlines apply to specific recipients/actions.
